summary: Iter189r validation — Manual Mode (list.tsx) and Autopilot/Player Mode (play.tsx) alternatives-swap flows work end-to-end (verified via Playwright on the client@crewfit.com account with today's workout 'Home Strength — Full Body'). Manual: tapping list-alt-swap-0 in the detail sheet successfully swapped 'Back Squat' → 'Bulgarian Split Squat' in the workout list AND the new exercise thumbnail re-hydrated. Autopilot: SWAP tile showed 3 purpose-labelled alternatives, tapping swap-btn-0 flipped tile back to IMAGE and header showed the new exercise name. Backend POST /api/workouts/{wid}/swap-exercise returns 200 with workout payload (V1 branch confirmed). Fix 1 padding sweep: all 17 target screens have the useBottomSafePad hook imported and applied — spot-checked 13 nutrition/social/roster screens load cleanly with no runtime crashes. CRITICAL BLOCKER FOUND in Guided Mode (guided.tsx): component crashes at initial render with ReferenceError: 'Cannot access currentEx before initialization' — this prevents the Guided-flow swap flow from being tested. Root cause: useCallback dep array on line 249/259 evaluates `currentEx?.name` at render time, but `const currentEx = workout?.exercises?.[exIdx]` is declared later on line 346, creating a JavaScript TDZ violation.

ui_bugs.issue: Component crashes on mount with 'ReferenceError: Cannot access currentEx before initialization'. The openHowTo useCallback (defined ~L243–L259) has `currentEx?.name` in its dependency array, but `const currentEx = workout?.exercises?.[exIdx]` is only declared later at ~L346. JS TDZ triggers on every render → root error boundary shows 'Something's off.'. Blocks ALL guided-flow testing, including the alternatives-swap flow this iteration was meant to validate.

react_native_issues.issue: 'Unexpected text node' warnings appear on login (whitespace between View children); shadow*/textShadow* deprecation warnings across app. Not tied to iter189r; log for later cleanup.

action_items: URGENT: Fix TDZ crash in /app/frontend/app/workout/[id]/guided.tsx — move `const currentEx = workout?.exercises?.[exIdx];` (and the derived `isCardio`, `targetSets`, `targetReps`, `restSec`, `workSec` if any are also referenced by hooks above) to BEFORE the `openHowTo` useCallback at line ~243. Recommend placing right after the useState/useRef declarations block around line ~280. After fix, re-verify the guided-flow SWAP (testID `gf-swap` → `swap-btn-0`) and confirm the how-to image survives the swap.
After the guided crash is fixed, re-run the guided-flow leg of the acceptance test to confirm reloadWorkout() re-hydrates the media (parity with list.tsx and play.tsx which both PASS).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix 2 (alternatives swap) implementation is clean where it works: list.tsx now uses `{ ex, section, idx }` detail state, ExerciseDetailSheet resolves the main-index by exercise_id → name → detail.idx fallback, and calls load() after swap. play.tsx tile carousel calls load() after swap and setTile('IMAGE') restores the media view.

The Guided TDZ bug appears to have existed BEFORE iter189r changes (git stash confirmed both `openHowTo` L233 and `currentEx` L335 in the pre-change file) — but it's now actively crashing the component. Either iter189r's addition of reloadWorkout() somewhere changed the render path, or the app previously never hit this render, or a Metro/JS runtime change now enforces TDZ. Regardless, must be fixed before guided-flow ships.

Fix 1 (padding) is applied uniformly — all 17 files import useBottomSafePad and each has one usage (social-studio.tsx has 2 usages, likely one per ScrollView). No runtime crashes on the 13 screens spot-checked.

rca_of_issue: Guided crash RCA: In guided.tsx, `const openHowTo = useCallback(fn, [paused, phase, warmupIdx, currentEx?.name, workout?.warmup])` is created ~L243–259. The dependency array is a JS expression evaluated synchronously at that line during render. `currentEx` is declared with `const` at ~L346 (later in the same function body), so at the point the deps array is built, `currentEx` is in the TDZ → ReferenceError: 'Cannot access currentEx before initialization'. Reproduction: log in as client@crewfit.com, navigate to /workout/e0e25bc8-f00a-465a-80e4-5c012649e39c/guided → root error boundary appears immediately. Mitigation (recommended): move the block `const currentEx = workout?.exercises?.[exIdx]; const isCardio = ...; const targetSets = ...; const targetReps = ...; const restSec = ...; const workSec = ...;` up to before the openHowTo useCallback declaration (a single-block relocation). No behaviour changes expected — these are derived values, purely a hoist.
